heading: Rules
intro: The owner's policies, by request type. Complaints and welfare concerns are always red, before these rules are checked. Rule names, steps and notes are shown as the owner wrote them.
readOnly: You can read the rules. Only the owner can edit or activate them.
newDraftFromActive: New draft from the active version
newDraftFromThis: Create a new draft from this version
noActive: No active version. Every request in {{category}} is yellow until one is activated.
draftReadOnly: This is a draft. Only the owner can edit or activate it.
activeLocked: Active versions cannot be edited, so past decisions always show the rules they used.
archivedLocked: Archived versions cannot be edited, so past decisions always show the rules they used.
createDraftToChange: Create a new draft to make changes.
describeStep1: Write the rule in plain English.
describeStep2: Tutor Compass proposes a structured draft and lists unclear wording and boundary cases.
describeStep3: You edit and test the draft.
describeStep4: You activate it. Nothing becomes active without your explicit action.
noErrors: No errors. This version can be activated.
noErrorsWarnings: No errors. This version can be activated once you acknowledge the warnings.
defaultRoute: Default route: anything no rule covers, and anything with missing, uncertain or conflicting information, is yellow. Complaints and welfare concerns are always red.
boundaryHint: What the engine would decide at each threshold, assuming every record is found and consistent. The case wording comes from the rule engine.
testHint: Runs the real engine on this version with sample evidence where the booking, payment and tutor slot are all found and consistent. Nothing is saved.
draftSaved: Draft saved. It is not active.
activated: Activated. New requests now use this version. Past decisions keep the version they used.
confirmDelete: Delete this draft? Active and archived versions are not affected.
title: Title
factsBeforeGreen: Facts that must be confirmed before green
name: Name
whyActivate: Why are you activating this version?
ackWarnings: I have read any warnings and checked the boundary cases.
activateHint: Activating archives the current active version. Past decisions keep the exact version they used. Only you can activate rules; AI cannot.
describeLabel: Describe the rule in your own words
describeHint: For example: “Admin can refund up to $60 if there is no complaint. $60 to $250 needs my approval. Anything over $250 is my call.” The rule proposer reads English most reliably.
savingCreatesDraft: Saving creates an inactive draft. You can edit and test it, and only you can activate it.

fact.reference: Booking reference matched to one booking
fact.payment_record: Matching payment record with no conflicts
fact.availability: Tutor availability for the new time
